title: Make swarm fixtures native
goal: Remove Unix-shell prerequisites from injected DAG workspace fixtures and exercise real native Windows descendant cancellation with positive, creation-time-bound process liveness and owned-handle cleanup. Preserve production isolation, conflict, and cancellation assertions.
acceptance: All susi-gawd-swarm library tests pass on native Windows without sh/ps/kill in PATH; both persisted DAG mutation cases preserve exact bytes and conflict evidence, and the cancellation regression observes a live identified descendant become exited through the real production runner.
progress: Original failures reproduced: workspace fixtures 3 passed, 2 failed; cancellation 0 passed, 1 failed. Injected native filesystem backend: 6 workspace tests passed. Stronger native descendant regression exposed a real production termination-order defect and remains failing pending the separate production repair. No test was skipped or weakened. Formatting and affected-crate strict Clippy passed.
